_note: Gas stations held for Joshua's review (created 2026-10-17). The game still uses the skip rule: a station that cannot sit clear of the streets is left out. This list is every station that, under the round-2 rules Joshua approved (fuel stations may sit across their own driveways; no part of a station may sit on a real street), either cannot be placed at all or has to move more than 2 units from its real spot. Joshua decides what happens to each one. Read-only in the editor; lands with Building Editor 1.7.2. [1.7.2: this file is downloaded from GitHub by the editor on open — never bundled. Editor-side station edits live in station-edits.json beside it.]
rules: Driveway = a road record with no name, class "local", at most 200 units long, whose own two ends do not join two different real streets (a segment joining two real streets is a street — Joshua's test). Named and classified streets always block. Station parts tested: canopy, kiosk/roof, columns, pumps.
